DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: アボカドをお探しですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。今晩のサラダに使いたいのですが、触って選ぶ方法が分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 当日のサラダ用に食べ頃の選び方を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I'd like to use them in a salad tonight, but I don't know how to choose them by touch.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to choose ripe avocados for a salad to eat today. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 強く押すと傷みますので、こちらで状態を見ます。おいくつ必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Pressing hard can damage them, so I'll check their condition for you. How many do you need?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二つお願いします。友人と二人で食べるので、今晩使える物を選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 当日二人で食べるため二つ必要と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Two, please. My friend and I will be eating them together, so I'd like ones we can use tonight.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you need two for two people to eat today. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの二つは食べ頃の目安で分けた商品です。中の状態までは保証できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: These two have been sorted according to a guide to ripeness. We can't guarantee their condition inside.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 外から全部は分からないのですね。家で切って困ったら、どう相談すればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 内部状態が保証されないことを確認し購入後の相談方法を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: So you can't tell everything from the outside. If I cut them at home and there's a problem, how should I ask about it?
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm that the condition inside isn't guaranteed and ask how to consult the store after purchase. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 購入日と商品を確認できるよう、レシートをお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please keep your receipt so we can confirm the purchase date and product.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: レシートを残します。切った後で状態が気になったら、写真も撮ってから問い合わせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: レシートと状態の写真を残して問い合わせると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll keep the receipt. If I'm concerned about their condition after cutting them, I'll take photos before contacting you too.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you'll keep the receipt and photos of the condition and contact the store. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お持ち帰りの時は、重い物を上に置かないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: When taking them home, please don't place heavy things on top of them.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 重い缶詰とは袋を分けます。選んでいただいた、この二つを買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 選んだ二つを購入し重い缶詰と袋を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll put them in a separate bag from the heavy canned goods. I'll buy these two you've selected for me.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Buy the two selected avocados and put them in a separate bag from heavy canned goods. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 二つで承りました。それでは、お会計へどうぞ。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Two, understood. Please go to the checkout. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: おむつの売場でお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble in the diaper section?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 同じ大きさに見える袋が並んでいます。赤ちゃんに合うか、商品を一枚出して見てもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 販売袋を開けておむつを確認してよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: There are bags lined up that look the same size. Can I take one diaper out of a product to see whether it will fit my baby?
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may open a bag for sale to examine a diaper. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 販売用の袋は開けないでください。こちらに形を見る見本があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please don't open the bags for sale. We have samples here for looking at the shape.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 見本があるのですね。今使っているのはテープで留める物です。パンツ型へ替えるか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 現在テープ型でパンツ型への変更を迷うと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: So there are samples. We're currently using the kind fastened with tapes. I'm unsure whether to switch to pull-ups.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you're currently using tape diapers and are undecided about switching to pull-ups. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 見本で形の違いは比べられます。サイズの目安は袋の表示をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can compare the shapes using the samples. Please check the size guidance on the bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 子どもの体重のメモを持ってきました。袋の目安と照らして、まず家で使う一袋だけ選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 体重メモと表示を照らして一袋を選びたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've brought a note of my child's weight. I'd like to compare it with the guidance on the bag and first choose just one pack to use at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want to compare your weight note with the label and choose one pack. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お子様に実際に合うかは、使用してみないと分からない場合もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Sometimes you can't know whether they really fit your child until you use them.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: パンツ型をまとめて買うのは、家族と相談してからにします。今日は使い慣れている物を買いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: パンツ型のまとめ買いは家族との相談後にし当日は使い慣れた型を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll discuss it with my family before buying pull-ups in bulk. Today I'd like to buy the type we're used to.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you'll wait to discuss it with family before buying pull-ups in bulk and want the familiar type today. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 見本はこちらへお戻しください。今日はどちらの型になさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please put the sample back here. Which type will you choose today?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は使い慣れているテープ型にします。パンツ型への変更は、家で家族と話してから決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: テープ型を購入しパンツ型への変更は家族と相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Today I'll take the tape type we're used to. I'll decide whether to switch to pull-ups after talking with my family at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Buy tape diapers and say you'll discuss switching to pull-ups with your family. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: かしこまりました。それでは、その商品をレジへお持ちください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Please take that product to the register. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 朝の準備で、確認したいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything you'd like to check while preparing this morning?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この箱のパンを売場へ出そうとしましたが、配達の注文票が付いていました。今は箱を開けずに置いています。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 注文票付きの箱を開けず売場用か確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I was about to put the bread in this box out for sale, but it had a delivery order attached. I've left it unopened for now.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you've left the box with an order attached unopened and check whether it's for the sales floor. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: それは配達分です。店頭分は、別の棚にまとめています。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: That's for delivery. The stock for the shop is grouped on a different shelf.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 配達分だったのですね。注文票を外さず、この箱は元の棚へ置きます。店頭分をどこで確認すればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 配達箱を元棚へ戻し店頭分の確認場所を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it was for delivery. I'll leave the order attached and put this box back on its original shelf. Where should I check the stock for the shop?
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Return the delivery box to its original shelf and ask where to check the shop stock. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの棚です。売場へ出す前に、今日の担当と品名を合わせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: This shelf here. Before putting it out for sale, check the product names with the person responsible today.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 初めて担当するので、見た目だけで選ばず、品名の表を持って確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 初担当で品名表を使い見た目だけで判断しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: It's my first time doing this task, so I'll use the product-name list to check instead of choosing just by appearance.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say it's your first time doing the task and you'll use the product-name list rather than judge only by appearance. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 配達の箱には、お客様ごとに分けた物が入っています。数を直す必要があれば私へ知らせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: The delivery boxes contain items separated for each customer. If any quantities need correcting, let me know.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。売場で一つ足りなくても、配達の箱から補うことはせず、先に報告します。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 売場不足を配達分で補わず責任者へ報告すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. Even if we're one short on the sales floor, I won't take one from a delivery box to make up the difference; I'll report it first.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you won't make up a sales-floor shortage from delivery stock and will report it to the supervisor. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今日は売場のこちらのパンから準備を進めましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Today let's start preparing these breads for the sales floor.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この棚の分だけ出します。配達の注文票がある箱を見つけたら、ほかの新人にも担当へ聞くよう伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 指定棚の商品を出し新人にも注文票確認を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll put out only the stock from this shelf. If I find a box with a delivery order, I'll also tell the other new staff to ask the person in charge.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Put out the products from the designated shelf and tell new staff to check the order slips too. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでお願いします。それでは、売場の準備をよろしくお願いします。お疲れさまです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please do that. Now, please get the sales floor ready. Thank you for your work.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご相談の受付ですね。ここで話しにくいことはございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're here to register for a consultation? Is there anything that's difficult to discuss here?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家で困っていることを相談したいです。ただ、同行している家族には、今ここで内容を聞かれたくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同行家族に聞かれず家庭の問題を相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to discuss a problem at home. But I don't want the family member who came with me to hear the details here now.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to discuss a family problem without your accompanying family member hearing. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 詳しい内容は、この開いた窓口で話さなくて構いません。担当への相談をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: You don't need to discuss the details at this open counter. Would you like to speak with the person in charge?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。家族は入口で待っています。呼び出す時に、大きな声で相談の内容を言わないでほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 呼出時に相談内容を大声で言わないよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. My family member is waiting at the entrance. When you call me, please don't say the subject of my consultation out loud.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask that the consultation subject not be said loudly when you're called. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そのご希望を担当に伝えます。連絡の方法についても、ご希望はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll pass that request to the person in charge. Do you have any preferences about how we contact you too?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 家の電話は家族も取るので使わないでください。まず、私の携帯に連絡できる時間を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 家の電話を避け本人携帯への連絡時間を相談したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please don't use the home phone, because my family answers it too. First I'd like to discuss when you can contact me on my mobile.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say to avoid the home phone and that you want to discuss times for contact on your own mobile. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 連絡先の扱いも含め、担当と確認しましょう。今日、先に確認したいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's check that with the person in charge, including how your contact information is handled. Is there anything you want to check first today?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 相談しただけで家族へ通知が出るのか心配です。どの情報を誰に伝えるか、説明を聞いてから話したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 情報共有と家族通知の扱いを話す前に確認したいと尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'm worried that simply having a consultation might trigger a notification to my family. I'd like to hear an explanation of which information will be shared with whom before I talk.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to check information sharing and family notifications before discussing the details. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当へ、その点を確認したいとお伝えします。ここで通知の有無を断定することはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll tell the person in charge you'd like to check that. We can't state here definitively whether a notification will be sent.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。内容を急いで書き込まず、プライバシーの扱いを担当から聞きたいです。案内をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 担当の説明を受けてから内容を伝えるため案内を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I understand. Rather than rushing to write down the details, I'd like to hear from the person in charge how privacy is handled. Please show me where to go.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask for guidance so you can hear the person's explanation before sharing the details. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、担当へおつなぎします。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll connect you to the person in charge now. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 野菜を切る作業は進んでいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: How is the vegetable chopping coming along?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 左手の人差し指を切ってしまいました。包丁は置いて、作業を止めています。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 左人差指を切り包丁を置いて作業を止めたと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've cut my left index finger. I've put down the knife and stopped working.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that you've cut your left index finger, put down the knife, and stopped working. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 担当を呼びます。切っていた野菜はどちらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll call the person in charge. Where are the vegetables you were cutting?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この台の上です。切り終えた物も隣にあります。血が付いたか、自分では全部確かめられていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 作業台の野菜の位置と血の付着が全て未確認と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: On this worktop. The ones I've finished cutting are beside them too. I haven't been able to check all of them myself for blood.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain where the vegetables are on the worktop and that you haven't checked all of them for blood. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 台の食品はこちらで確認します。いったん手を付けず、こちらへ座ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll check the food on the worktop. Please leave it untouched for now and sit here.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ここに座ります。私が触っていた物が分かるよう、使っていた皿もそのまま残しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 座って待ち触れた食品と皿をそのまま残したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll sit here. I've also left the dishes I was using as they were so you can tell what I touched.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you'll sit and wait and have left the food you touched and the dishes as they were. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その場所も確認します。まずけがの対応を担当へ相談しますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll check that area too. First I'll consult the person in charge about attending to your injury.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。料理がまだ途中ですが、続きの作業は後で相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: けがの確認を優先し続きの作業は後で相談したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. The cooking is still unfinished, but I'd like to discuss the remaining work later.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Prioritize checking the injury and say you'd like to discuss the remaining work later. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 参加の方法も、確認が終わってから相談しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's also discuss how you can take part after the checks are finished.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は切る作業をやめたいです。見学に変えられるか、担当の確認後に教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 当日の切る作業をやめ見学への変更を確認後に尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'd like to stop chopping for today. After the person in charge checks, please tell me whether I can switch to observing.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you want to stop chopping today and ask about switching to observation after the checks. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分かりました。まず担当を呼びますので、こちらでお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll call the person in charge first, so please wait here. Goodbye for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お薬を使った後のことで、ご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about something that happened after taking medicine?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨夜、薬を飲んだ後で吐きました。薬も出たのか分からず、もう一度飲む前に相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 服薬後嘔吐で薬も出たか不明と追加前に相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I vomited last night after taking my medicine. I don't know whether the medicine came up too, so I'd like to ask before taking it again.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you vomited after taking medicine, don't know whether the medicine came up too, and want advice before an additional dose. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 飲んだ時刻と、吐いた時刻は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you know what time you took it and what time you vomited?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 薬は夜九時、吐いたのは九時半ごろです。吐いた物の中に薬があったかは確かめられていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 服薬九時嘔吐九時半と薬の排出未確認を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I took the medicine at nine at night and vomited around nine thirty. I haven't been able to confirm whether there was medicine in the vomit.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you took the medicine at nine and vomited at nine thirty, and haven't confirmed whether the medicine came up. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 分かる範囲で結構です。追加して飲んだ分はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Just tell us what you know. Have you taken any extra doses?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありません。吐いたから全部なくなったと思って、同じ量を足すことはしませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 追加服用なしで全部失ったと自己判断しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: No. I didn't assume that vomiting meant all the medicine was gone and take the same amount again.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you haven't taken an extra dose and haven't assumed all the medicine was lost. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今のご様子も伺います。現在も吐き気はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll also ask how you are now. Do you still feel nauseated?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 少し気持ちが悪いです。家族が家にいます。薬のことだけでなく、今の症状も相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 現在の吐気と家族が在宅の状況を申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I feel a little sick. My family is at home. I'd like advice about my current symptoms as well as the medicine.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report your current nausea and that your family is at home. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 症状とお薬のことを確認する担当へ、順におつなぎします。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll connect you in turn with the staff who can check your symptoms and medicine.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。薬の名前と昨夜の時刻を伝え、次に使う分をどうするか説明を受けます。自分で埋め合わせずに相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 薬名時刻を伝え次の使用の専門説明を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I'll give the medicine's name and last night's times and hear an explanation of what to do about the next dose. I'll ask rather than try to make up for it myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Give the medicine name and times and ask for professional guidance about the next use. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 症状とお薬のことを担当へ引き継ぎます。それでは、失礼します。お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll pass on the information about your symptoms and medicine. Goodbye, and please take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの箱をお預かりして、お送りしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Shall we accept this box here and send it for you?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: お願いします。ただ、同じ箱を自宅へ取りに来てもらう予約もしていました。二重にならないよう取り消したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 窓口持込と同じ箱の自宅集荷予約が残ると申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, please. But I also booked a pickup from my home for the same box. I'd like to cancel that to avoid a duplicate.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that a home pickup booking remains for the same box you're bringing to the counter. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらで箱を出すことと、集荷予約の取消しは別に確認が必要です。予約の控えはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Sending the box here and canceling the pickup booking need to be checked separately. Do you have your booking confirmation?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 携帯にあります。今日の午後に来てもらう予定でしたが、予定が変わって自分で持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 午後の予約控えと持込に変更した経緯を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's on my phone. They were due to come this afternoon, but my plans changed, so I brought it myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the afternoon booking confirmation and explain how you changed to bringing it in yourself. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 予約した窓口へ、まだ取りに来る予定が残っているかご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check with the service where you booked whether they're still scheduled to come and collect it.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。ここで箱を渡したから自動で予約が消えるとは思わず、控えの連絡先に伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 発送で自動取消と思わず予約連絡先へ確認すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I won't assume handing over the box here automatically cancels the booking. I'll contact the details on the confirmation.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you won't assume shipment automatically cancels the pickup and will check with the booking contact. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 集荷を頼んだ箱は、今お持ちのこの一つで間違いありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Just to confirm, is this one box you're carrying now the box you requested pickup for?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、別の箱は家にありません。家族にも、今日ほかの荷物を渡す予約ではないと連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家に別箱がなく家族にも集荷不要を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, there's no other box at home. I'll also tell my family that the booking isn't for handing over some other parcel today.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say there's no other box at home and you'll also tell your family a pickup isn't needed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 取消しについて確認してから、発送の受付を進めることもできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: We can also proceed with accepting the shipment after you've checked the cancellation.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 先に連絡します。予約の番号と名前を伝え、取消しの返事を聞いてから、この箱を窓口で出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 番号と名前で取消確認後に窓口発送を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll contact them first. I'll give the booking number and name, hear their confirmation of cancellation, and then send this box from the counter.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask to send the box at the counter after confirming cancellation using the booking number and name. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、ご確認の後にお待ちしております。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ANJO-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll be waiting after you've checked. Goodbye for now.

DLG-SC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 織り始める前に、動きを練習しましょうか。
DLG-SC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-01.translation: Shall we practice the movements before starting to weave?

DLG-SC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。足を踏む時に手も動かそうとして、順番が分からなくなりました。最初は手を止めて足だけ見たいです。
DLG-SC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 手足同時で混乱し足だけ先に見たいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I tried to move my hands while pressing with my feet and got confused about the order. First I'd like to keep my hands still and just watch the foot movements.
DLG-SC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say coordinating your hands and feet confused you and you'd like to watch just the feet first. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず私が足元の動きを見せます。糸はまだ通さずにご覧ください。
DLG-SC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-03.translation: First I'll show you the foot movements. Watch without threading the yarn yet.

DLG-SC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 糸を通さずに見ます。足を踏んでから戻すまで、どこで止めるかも説明してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 糸を通さず止める位置も実演依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll watch without threading it. Could you also explain where to pause between pressing down and returning?
DLG-SC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask for a demonstration without threading the yarn, including where to stop. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この位置でいったん止め、戻す動きまでを一組にします。
DLG-SC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-05.translation: Pause at this position, and treat the movement through returning as one set.

DLG-SC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 踏んで戻すところまでで一回なのですね。足の動きだけ、私も試していいですか。
DLG-SC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 踏み戻し一回を自分も試したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-06.translation: So pressing and returning together make one repetition. May I also try just the foot movements?
DLG-SC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to try one press-and-return repetition yourself. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、私の合図で一度だけ試してください。
DLG-SC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then please try it just once on my signal.

DLG-SC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一組できました。急いで続けるより、今の動きをもう一度ゆっくり繰り返したいです。
DLG-SC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 一組後ゆっくり再練習を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've completed one set. Rather than rushing to continue, I'd like to repeat that movement slowly once more.
DLG-SC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: After one set, ask to practice again slowly. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: よいですよ。手と合わせるのは、その練習が済んでからにしましょう。
DLG-SC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-09.translation: Of course. Let's wait until that practice is finished before combining it with your hands.

DLG-SC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二回目は順番が分かりました。次の練習で手の動きも教えてください。
DLG-SC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 足の順番を理解し次回の手の練習を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-10.translation: I understood the order on the second try. Please teach me the hand movements in the next practice.
DLG-SC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you understand the foot sequence and want to practice the hands next time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 今日は足の練習までにしましょう。次は手の動きを説明します。お疲れさまでした。それでは、またお待ちしています。
DLG-SC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let's stop at foot practice today. Next time I'll explain the hand movements. Thank you for your efforts. We look forward to seeing you again.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 開店前の準備を少し見学できますか。値札を並べているところに興味があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 開店準備と値札作業の見学を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED-.translation: Could I watch a little of the preparations before opening? I'm interested in how you're arranging the price tags.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Ask to observe opening preparations and the price-tag work. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 準備中は荷物の出入りがあります。店の外から短くご覧になる形でよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED-.translation: Goods move in and out during preparations. Would watching briefly from outside the shop be all right?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: はい。中へ入らず、荷物が通る所も空けます。値札を並べる作業に興味があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 外で荷物通行を空け値札作業を見ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED-.translation: Yes. I won't go inside, and I'll keep the route for goods clear. I'm interested in the work of arranging price tags.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Say you'll watch the price-tag work from outside while keeping the goods route clear. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 値札の用意は、こちらの机でしています。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED-.translation: We prepare the price tags at this table.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 値札の確認について、あとで一つ聞きたいです。今は作業を見て、一段落するまで待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 質問を作業区切りまで待つと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED-.translation: I'd like to ask one thing about checking price tags later. For now, I'll watch the work and wait until you reach a stopping point.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Say you'll wait until a break in the work to ask your question. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 質問は、この箱の準備が終わってから伺えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED-.translation: We can take your question after we've finished preparing this box.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 箱が通れるよう、こちらへ離れます。準備が終わるまで外で見ています。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 箱の通行を空け外で準備終了を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED-.translation: I'll move over here so the box can pass. I'll watch from outside until the preparations are finished.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Keep the box's route clear and wait outside for the preparations to finish. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: ご協力ありがとうございます。これで一つの準備が済みました。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED-.translation: Thank you for cooperating. That's one stage of the preparations finished.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。値札を出す前にどんなことを確認するか、一つだけ聞かせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 値札を出す前の確認事項を一つ尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED-.translation: Thank you. Please let me ask just one thing: what do you check before putting out a price tag?
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Ask one thing about what is checked before price tags are put out. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 品名と販売する物が合っているか確認します。見学はここまでです。お越しいただきありがとうございました。それでは、よい一日を。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-02-001-SHARED-.translation: We check whether the product name matches the item being sold. That concludes the observation. Thank you for coming. Have a good day.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: ラーメンをお持ちしました。ほかに必要な物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED-.translation: Here is your ramen. Is there anything else you need?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 箸で麺を取るのがまだ難しいです。服に汁をはねさせそうなので、フォークがあれば借りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 箸で麺が難しくフォーク借用を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED-.translation: I'm still finding it difficult to pick up noodles with chopsticks. I'm worried I'll splash broth on my clothes, so I'd like to borrow a fork if you have one.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Explain that noodles are difficult with chopsticks and ask to borrow a fork. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: フォークをご用意できます。れんげもお使いになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED-.translation: We can provide a fork. Would you like a soup spoon too?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: フォークとれんげを両方お願いします。家では箸を練習していますが、今日は温かいうちに食べたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 両方の道具を頼み今日は食事を優先したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED-.translation: Please give me both a fork and a soup spoon. I'm practicing chopsticks at home, but today I'd like to eat while the food is warm.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Ask for both utensils and say you'd like to prioritize eating today. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: こちらのフォークとれんげをどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED-.translation: Here are your fork and soup spoon.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。使っていた箸は、どこへ置けばいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 使用箸を安全に置く場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED-.translation: Thank you. Where should I put the chopsticks I was using?
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Ask where to safely put the used chopsticks. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: この箸置きをお使いください。

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: この箸置きですね。フォークなら少しずつ取れそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 箸置きの位置を確認し少量ずつ食べると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED-.translation: This chopstick rest, right? With a fork, I think I can pick up a little at a time.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Confirm the chopstick rest's location and say you'll eat a little at a time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 熱さにもお気をつけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED-.translation: Please be careful of the heat too.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: はい。少し冷ましてから食べます。周りと同じ道具でなくても、自分で頼めたので安心しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 熱さを確かめ自己適道具を頼めた安心を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED-.translation: Yes. I'll let it cool a little before eating. Even though I'm not using the same utensils as everyone else, I'm relieved I was able to ask for what I need myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Check the heat and express relief that you could ask for utensils suitable for yourself. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: どうぞご自身のペースでお召し上がりください。それでは、ごゆっくり。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-03-001-SHARED-.translation: Please eat at your own pace. Enjoy your meal.
